name: template-library-shareable-amended
body:
source: change request "let theme CSS reference any file in the template library". global.constraint.template-library-shareable said a theme's theme.css "reaches only its own theme directory and the resolved library's shared media/ tree" — the exact restriction being lifted.

Resolution [autonomous]: amended that sentence to the new reach — a theme's theme.css, and every CSS it imports, may reach its own directory, the shared media/ tree (reserved `media:`) and another theme's files (reserved `theme:<name>/`), both valid for url() and @import (theme-media-references) — while keeping the self-contained/relocatable law: every target stays inside the library root and no reference escapes it (no absolute paths, no `..` escape, no outside scheme). The first sentence (relocatable unit; no references into slides/ or the project assets/) is unchanged. global.constraint.theme-tokens-only needs no change: the new reach adds no visual values — every value still comes from the active theme's tokens — so no amendment was made there. [autonomous]
